trigger: OTA upload form render; .add-user-form class placed on the wrapping <div> instead of the <form> that carries display:flex
summary: flex-wrap: wrap added to .add-user-form never reaches the OTA form's actual flex container (the nested <form>, not the wrapping <div>); button was reachable only by coincidence via the compression rules, not by wrapping.
classification_rationale: code comment claimed the row 'now wraps' when flex-wrap was inert on this element

summary: Fixed by commit 80c67a1a5: moved class="add-user-form" onto the <form>, removed wrapper <div> and duplicated inline flex properties. Re-verified clean by 5 independent re-reviewers (security-guardian, docs-writer, cpp-expert, cpp-safety, architect) plus author's empirical headless-browser screenshot (row now genuinely wraps, Upload drops to its own line when content doesn't fit).

trigger: any page load of /settings (or any fragment rendering .pw-form) after commit 967cec801
summary: // line comments (C++/JS style) used inside a real CSS <style> block served to the browser; CSS has no // comment syntax, so the // text is parsed as part of the next rule's selector prelude, which then fails to parse, and the entire .pw-form rule is silently dropped by the browser's CSS error recovery. Independently found by happy-path, unhappy-path, and consistency-auditor in the same Gate 4 wave (none could see the others' output). Verified empirically via headless Chromium getComputedStyle: margin-top/border-top-width/padding-top fell back to the base .add-user-form values instead of .pw-form's override, on every render of the password-change/reset form.
classification_rationale: comment syntax itself broke the rule it was describing

summary: Fixed by commit 2fcb68133: // changed to /* */ block comment. Verified empirically (headless Chromium getComputedStyle before/after: margin-top 16px->4px, border-top-width 1px->0px, matching .pw-form's intended override). Re-confirmed clean by 3 independent re-reviewers (security-guardian, cpp-expert, cpp-safety).

trigger: static code read of settings_ui.cpp after .add-user-form gained its own flex-wrap: wrap
summary: .pw-form's own flex-wrap: wrap became redundant once the base .add-user-form rule gained the same property directly; harmless dead CSS, optional cleanup only.
classification_rationale: stylistic/redundancy observation, not a code defect at the time it was raised

summary: Removed in commit 967cec801. This cleanup itself introduced finding 5572-css-doubleslash-comment (wrong comment delimiter used while editing) — see caused_by on that finding. The underlying dead-CSS observation is correctly resolved in the final diff (967cec801 + 2fcb68133 together).
